paper_title: Robust bounds on ALP dark matter from dwarf spheroidal galaxies in the optical MUSE-Faint survey
notes: Paper presents new 95% C.L. upper limits on the ALP-two-photon coupling g_agamma from radiative ALP DM decay searches in five dwarf spheroidal galaxies (Leo T, Sculptor, Eridanus 2, Grus 1, Hydra II) using MUSE spectroscopic data, for ALP masses 2.7-5.3 eV. The text states the coupling is constrained at a level around 1e-12 GeV^-1 with significant channel-to-channel fluctuations; the limit improves mildly from low to high mass. Exact numerical values are only available in Figs. 2 (NFW), 4 (coreNFWtides), and 5 (combined); the data_points above are a smooth approximation of the combined NFW bound envelope, not digitized values. A gap exists near m_a ~ 4.16-4.26 eV due to the AO laser blocking filter (5820-5970 A). Assumes ALPs constitute all DM in the dwarf halos (decay signal ~ rho, not local density); no local DM density assumption applies. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
